name: Kapture Screenshot Helper
description: Companion for the Kapture screenshot app. Makes Kapture's capture shortcut take flash-free screenshots on Wayland: the extension owns the shortcut, captures only when you press it, and opens the image in Kapture. It exposes no API, so no other program can take screenshots through it. Requires Kapture: https://github.com/yeakiniqra/Kapture
